permissionDenied.title: Not available for this demo role
permissionDenied.body: The {{role}} demo role cannot open this screen. This attempt was recorded in the audit log.
permissionDenied.navHint: Not available for this demo role

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: This address does not match any screen in this demo.

routeError.title: This screen could not be shown
routeError.description: Something went wrong while showing this screen. Try again, or reset the demo from Demo tools.

VALIDATION_ERROR.title: Check the highlighted fields
VALIDATION_ERROR.body: Some information is missing or not valid. Correct the highlighted fields and save again.

FORBIDDEN.title: Not permitted for this demo role or facility
FORBIDDEN.body: This record is outside the active demo role or facility. The attempt was recorded in the audit log.

NOT_FOUND.title: Record not found
NOT_FOUND.body: This record does not exist in the demo data, or it was removed by a demo reset.

CONFLICT.title: Someone else changed this record
CONFLICT.body: A newer version was saved while you were working. Review the latest version before saving again.

DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE.title: The service could not complete this request
DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE.body: A service needed for this action is unavailable. Nothing extra was saved; try again.

OFFLINE.title: You are offline
OFFLINE.body: Simulated offline — changes cannot be saved. Turn the fault off in Settings and try again.

TIMEOUT.title: The request timed out
TIMEOUT.body: The response did not arrive. It may already be saved — trying again is safe and will not save twice.
